## Qualcomm Signs Up-to-$60B Multi-Generation AI Chip Deal with Amazon, Receives ~$4B Stock Warrant

A named, multi-generation hyperscaler custom-chip commitment of this scale signals accelerating diversification away from merchant silicon — a structural headwind for NVDA/AVGO/MRVL thesis holders that warrants reassessing hyperscaler-concentration assumptions. The equity warrant component is unusual and aligns Qualcomm's incentives with AWS long-term, deepening the competitive moat.

- Amazon and Qualcomm agreed to a multi-generation custom data-center AI chip supply deal valued at up to $60B, according to multiple outlets.
- As part of the deal structure, Qualcomm offered Amazon the right to purchase approximately $4B in QCOM stock (roughly 25M share warrant), per several headlines.
- QCOM shares surged sharply on the news, with outlets variously reporting gains of ~5% to ~10% — indicating some spread in intraday readings but consistent directional strength.
- The deal is framed as a custom silicon win for Qualcomm in AI data-center infrastructure, a segment historically dominated by merchant silicon vendors.
- Coverage specifically flags competitive implications for NVDA, AVGO, and MRVL as hyperscaler custom-chip spend potentially displaces merchant GPU/ASIC volumes.
